controls.title: Ensure external file sharing in Teams is enabled for only approved cloud storage services
controls.description: Only cloud storage providers the organisation has approved may be surfaced inside Teams.
controls.rationale: Unapproved storage providers inside Teams are an uncontrolled path for data to leave the tenant.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will no longer be able to attach files from unapproved third-party storage in Teams.
controls.remediationProcedure:
1. Connect to Teams PowerShell using Connect-MicrosoftTeams
2. Run the following PowerShell command to disable external providers that are not authorized. (the example disables Citrix Files, DropBox, Box, Google Drive and Egnyte)
$storageParams = @{
  AllowGoogleDrive = $false
  AllowShareFile = $false
  AllowBox = $false
  AllowDropBox = $false
  AllowEgnyte = $false
}
Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration @storageParams

audit.name: Read the Teams third-party storage providers
audit.payload: Get-CsTeamsClientConfiguration | Select-Object AllowDropBox, AllowBox, AllowGoogleDrive, AllowShareFile, AllowEgnyte | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

assertions.failure: Dropbox is available as a storage provider in Teams ({actual}).
Box is available as a storage provider in Teams ({actual}).
Google Drive is available as a storage provider in Teams ({actual}).
Citrix ShareFile is available as a storage provider in Teams ({actual}).
Egnyte is available as a storage provider in Teams ({actual}).

remediation.name: Disable unapproved Teams storage providers
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration -Identity Global -AllowDropBox $false -AllowBox $false -AllowGoogleDrive $false -AllowShareFile $false -AllowEgnyte $false
Get-CsTeamsClientConfiguration | Select-Object AllowDropBox, AllowBox, AllowGoogleDrive, AllowShareFile, AllowEgnyte | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous storage provider configuration
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration -Identity Global -AllowDropBox {{AllowDropBox}} -AllowBox {{AllowBox}} -AllowGoogleDrive {{AllowGoogleDrive}} -AllowShareFile {{AllowShareFile}} -AllowEgnyte {{AllowEgnyte}}
Get-CsTeamsClientConfiguration | Select-Object AllowDropBox, AllowBox, AllowGoogleDrive, AllowShareFile, AllowEgnyte | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure users can't send emails to a channel email address
controls.description: Channel email addresses must be disabled.
controls.rationale: A channel email address accepts mail from outside the tenant and bypasses normal mail-flow inspection.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Existing channel email addresses will stop receiving mail.
controls.cisControl: CIS Control 9: Email and Web Browser Protections
controls.nistCategory: PR.PS-05 Installation of unauthorized software is prevented

assertions.failure: Email into channel is {actual}; external senders can post directly into Teams channels.

remediation.name: Disable email into channel
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration -Identity Global -AllowEmailIntoChannel $false
Get-CsTeamsClientConfiguration | Select-Object AllowEmailIntoChannel | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous channel email setting
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsClientConfiguration -Identity Global -AllowEmailIntoChannel {{AllowEmailIntoChannel}}
Get-CsTeamsClientConfiguration | Select-Object AllowEmailIntoChannel | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure 'external access' is restricted in the Teams admin center
controls.description: Federation must be limited to an explicit list of approved partner domains.
controls.rationale: Open federation lets any Teams tenant in the world start a conversation with your staff.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users can only chat with partners on the approved domain list.
controls.remediationProcedure:
1. Connect to Teams PowerShell using Connect-MicrosoftTeams
2. Run one of the following commands:
- To allow only specific external domains run these commands replacing the example domains with approved domains:
$list = New-Object Collections.Generic.List[String]
$list.add("contoso.com")
$list.add("fabrikam.com")
Set-CsTenantFederationConfiguration -AllowFederatedUsers $true -AllowedDomainsAsAList $list
- To block all external domains:
Set-CsTenantFederationConfiguration -AllowFederatedUsers $false

audit.name: Read the tenant federation configuration
audit.payload: Get-CsTenantFederationConfiguration | Select-Object AllowFederatedUsers, AllowedDomains, AllowTeamsConsumer | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress

assertions.failure: Federation is open to every Teams tenant: AllowFederatedUsers is on and the allowed domain list is {actual}.
assertions.hint: Either set AllowFederatedUsers to $false, or populate AllowedDomainsAsAList with the approved partner domains only.

controls.title: Ensure communication with unmanaged Teams users is disabled
controls.description: Teams accounts not managed by an organisation must not be able to communicate with tenant users.
controls.rationale: Consumer Teams accounts are free and unverifiable, which makes them the cheapest possible vector for social engineering.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Users will no longer be able to chat with personal Teams accounts.
controls.auditProcedure:
To audit using the UI:
1. Navigate to Microsoft Teams admin center https://admin.teams.microsoft.com/.
2. Click to expand Users select External access.
3. Scroll to Teams accounts not managed by an organization
4. Ensure People in my organization can communicate with Teams users whose accounts aren't managed by an organization is Off

Get-CsTenantFederationConfiguration | fl AllowTeamsConsumer

audit.name: Read the unmanaged Teams user setting

assertions.failure: Communication with unmanaged (consumer) Teams accounts is {actual}.

remediation.name: Block unmanaged Teams accounts
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTenantFederationConfiguration -AllowTeamsConsumer $false -AllowTeamsConsumerInbound $false
Get-CsTenantFederationConfiguration | Select-Object AllowTeamsConsumer, AllowTeamsConsumerInbound | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous consumer federation setting
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTenantFederationConfiguration -AllowTeamsConsumer {{AllowTeamsConsumer}} -AllowTeamsConsumerInbound {{AllowTeamsConsumerInbound}}
Get-CsTenantFederationConfiguration | Select-Object AllowTeamsConsumer, AllowTeamsConsumerInbound | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure anonymous users can't join a meeting
controls.description: The global meeting policy must block anonymous participants.
controls.rationale: Anonymous join means an unauthenticated party can sit silently in a meeting where confidential material is discussed.
controls.userImpact: Impact: External participants will need to authenticate before joining.

audit.name: Read the anonymous join setting
audit.payload: Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object Identity, AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting, AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting, DesignatedPresenterRoleMode | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

remediation.name: Block anonymous meeting join
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting $false
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object Identity, AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous anonymous join setting
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting {{AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting}}
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object Identity, AllowAnonymousUsersToJoinMeeting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure anonymous users and dial-in callers can't start a meeting
controls.description: Anonymous participants must not be able to start a meeting on their own.
controls.rationale: If anonymous users can start a meeting they can also use the tenant's conferencing resources unattended.

audit.name: Read the anonymous meeting start setting

remediation.name: Block anonymous meeting start
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting $false
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous anonymous start setting
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting {{AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting}}
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object AllowAnonymousUsersToStartMeeting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure only organizers and co-organizers can present
controls.description: The default presenter role must be restricted to organisers.
controls.rationale: Anyone who can present can share their screen to the whole meeting, including an uninvited guest who got the link.
controls.userImpact: Impact: Presenters must be promoted explicitly by the organiser.

assertions.failure: The default presenter mode is {actual}; CIS requires {expected}.

remediation.name: Restrict presenting to organisers
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -DesignatedPresenterRoleMode OrganizerOnlyUserOverride
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object DesignatedPresenterRoleMode | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous presenter mode
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity Global -DesignatedPresenterRoleMode {{DesignatedPresenterRoleMode}}
Get-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy | Select-Object DesignatedPresenterRoleMode | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

controls.title: Ensure users can report security concerns in Teams
controls.description: End-user reporting of suspicious Teams messages must be enabled and routed to the security team.
controls.rationale: User reporting is the fastest detection channel for a phishing campaign that reached the inbox.

audit.name: Read the Teams security reporting setting

assertions.failure: Users cannot report suspicious Teams messages ({actual}).

remediation.name: Enable end-user security reporting in Teams
remediation.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowSecurityEndUserReporting $true
Get-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy | Select-Object Identity, AllowSecurityEndUserReporting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

rollback.name: Restore the previous reporting setting
rollback.payload:
Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowSecurityEndUserReporting {{AllowSecurityEndUserReporting}}
Get-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy | Select-Object Identity, AllowSecurityEndUserReporting | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
